name: trace-first-pixel-judge
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" proofs/captures/trace-first-pixel.png --description "A GPU sphere-traced render of exactly two flat-shaded solid shapes on a dark background: a reddish cube on the left and a blue sphere on the right, both fully visible with clean silhouettes"

name: trace-first-pixel-accept
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/trace-first-pixel/capture.png --description "Both a reddish box on the left and a blue sphere on the right are fully visible, solid and separated on a dark background, with recognizable clean silhouettes. This is the first GPU world-volume image." --min-score 6

name: trace-volume-baseline-judge
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" proofs/captures/trace-first-pixel-baseline.png --description "A GPU sphere-traced render of exactly two solid shapes on a dark background: a reddish cube on the left and a blue sphere on the right, both fully visible with clean silhouettes, with no mesh in the scene. The image is the full screen resolution trace of the five-mip stamped world volume." --min-score 6

name: trace-volume-occlusion-judge
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" proofs/captures/trace-first-pixel-occlusion.png --description "On a dark background, a GPU sphere-traced reddish cube on the left and blue sphere on the right; a flat green rectangular slab floats in front of the left part of the cube and cleanly hides that part of it, while the cube centre and the whole sphere stay visible. The mesh and the traced surface compose by depth." --min-score 6
